response_kit.customer_warning_notice: Scam warning: sites and accounts pretending to be Quillbrook Goods are selling fake 'warehouse closing' and 'outlet' sales and running a fake customer service line. Our only websites are quillbrook.example, shop.quillbrook.example and help.quillbrook.example, and our Instagram is @quillbrookgoods. Fakes seen so far: quillbrook-outlet[.]example, quillbrook-help[.]example, quillbr00k[.]example, ads from an advertiser called 'Quillbrook Support Center' and the Instagram account @quillbrook.goods.official. We never run a closing-down sale, never ask for a code sent to your phone and never ask for a shipping fee for a giveaway. If you paid on another site, contact your card issuer and send us the link at help.quillbrook.example.
response_kit.support_reply_template: Thanks for telling us, and I'm sorry this happened. Could you send the website address or account you used, the date and any emails or texts you received? Our only websites are quillbrook.example, shop.quillbrook.example and help.quillbrook.example. If the site you used isn't one of those, it isn't ours and we can't see or refund the order, so please contact your card issuer today and tell them the charge was made on a fraudulent site. If you shared a code sent to your phone, change your passwords and tell your bank. We've logged the site and are reporting it to have it taken down.
response_kit.for_your_lawyer: trademark letters and domain disputes (UDRP) for quillbrook-outlet[.]example, quillbrook-help[.]example, quillbr00k[.]example: the evidence packs above are ready; no opinion on the claim is given here
